quarterly_data.quarter: Apple press release: Apple debuts iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are powered by A20 Pro, 'built using the latest 2-nanometer process technology': 50 percent more memory bandwidth than A19 Pro, a new 6-core CPU with integrated Neural Accelerators, a new 7-core GPU up to 40 percent faster than A19 Pro, and a Dual 16-core Neural Engine with 32 total cores for double the AI processing power of A19 Pro. Packaging change: A20 Pro 'introduces custom packaging inspired by M-series Apple silicon that places the silicon die side by side with the memory, removing the memory from the thermal path of the chip', so A20 Pro attaches directly to a next-generation vapor chamber (three times more surface area than on iPhone 17 Pro; up to a 40 percent gain in sustained performance). Both models carry N1, an Apple-designed wireless networking chip (Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, Thread), and iPhone 18 Pro introduces C2, Apple's next-generation cellular modem system (meaningfully faster uploads than C1X while consuming 15 percent less energy; now supports mmWave in the U.S.). Pre-orders begin September 12 with availability September 18 in more than 65 countries and regions (20 more on September 25); iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199 and iPhone 18 Pro Max at $1,299, in 256GB, 512GB, 1TB and 2TB capacities. The release does not name the foundry.
quarterly_data.figure: A20 Pro on 2-nanometer; 50 percent more memory bandwidth than A19 Pro; die side by side with memory in new package; C2 modem 15 percent less energy; available September 18; from $1,199
